newsitem.title: USA: Frisch's closes restaurants, takes charge.
newsitem.headline: Frisch's closes restaurants, takes charge.

text.p: Frisch's Restaurants Inc said Tuesday that it is closing 15 underperforming restaurants and that it expects to take a $4.0 to $4.5 million pretax charge for impairment of assets against its earnings for fiscal 1997.
Frisch's said the 15 restaurants sustained pretax losses of about $2.2 million in the fiscal year ended June 1, 1997.
Ten of the restaurants are located in Indianapolis, four are located in central Ohio and one in Louisville, Kentucky.
All employees in the affected locations will be offered employment in other company restaurants.
